summary: Phase 6 review: Live FX rates (open.er-api.com), Vault history events, and Mobile App 'Coming Soon' page validated end-to-end. 8/8 backend pytest passed and all key frontend selectors/integrations verified.
critical_code_review_comments: HTML hydration warnings observed on /wallet/multi-currency about <span> inside <tbody>/<tr>. These are caused by the Emergent visual-editor instrumentation (data-ve-dynamic span wrappers around <tr>) and not by the app's own JSX. No functional impact, but worth flagging if the editor instrumentation generates wrappers around <table> children — consider opting tbody rows out of the visual-editor wrapper to silence the warning.
seed_data_creation: Created 1 vault doc 'Test History Phase6.txt' via upload+verify+download+certify; events: created, verified, downloaded, certified (ordered asc by 'at').
context_for_next_testing_agent: Backend test file /app/backend/tests/test_iter65_phase6.py is the regression suite for Phase 6 (FX live rates + vault events). It loads REACT_APP_BACKEND_URL from /app/frontend/.env when missing in env. All Phase 6 endpoints work: GET /api/multi-currency/rates returns sources+timestamps+live_provider+next_refresh_at; POST /api/multi-currency/rates/refresh returns refreshed=true count=5; vault upload/verify/download/certify auto-record events with _id excluded; GET /api/vault/documents/{id}/history returns {document,events,count} sorted asc and returns 404 for non-owned/non-existent docs. Frontend: /mobile-app shows mobile-hero-title='Tu banca institucional, en tu bolsillo.', store badges have cursor:not-allowed and opacity-90, waitlist form present (mobile-waitlist-form/input/submit), sidebar has link to /mobile-app with label 'App Móvil · Próximamente'. /wallet/multi-currency shows live badge 'open.er-api.com', rate-source-USD='Live', rate-ts-USD='hace 1 min'. /wallet/vault shows vault-history-{id} button per doc, and modal vault-history-modal opens with timeline rows vault-history-event-created and vault-history-event-verified.
